initial.code: Clear[mu,phi]; p=3/(8 Pi) (1-mu^2); u={Sqrt[1-mu^2] Cos[phi],Sqrt[1-mu^2] Sin[phi],mu}; norm=Integrate[p,{mu,-1,1},{phi,0,2 Pi}]; m1=Integrate[p #,{mu,-1,1},{phi,0,2 Pi}]&/@u; m2=Table[Integrate[p u[[i]] u[[j]],{mu,-1,1},{phi,0,2 Pi}],{i,3},{j,3}]; q=Simplify[m2-IdentityMatrix[3]/3]; <|"normalization"->norm,"mean_direction"->m1,"second_moment"->m2,"STF_second_moment"->q,"eigenvalues"->Eigenvalues[m2],"quadrupole_P2"->Integrate[2 Pi p LegendreP[2,mu],{mu,-1,1}],"residuals"->{norm-1,Tr[m2]-1,q[[3,3]]+2/15,q[[1,1]]-1/15}|>

content.text: Failure["EvaluationTimeExceeded", <|"MessageTemplate" -> "Evaluation exceeded the `1` second time limit.", "MessageParameters" -> {5}|>]

repair.diagnosis: Reduce azimuthal integration analytically before polynomial marginal integration
repair.code: Clear[mu]; p=3(1-mu^2)/4; a=Integrate[p,{mu,-1,1}]; b=Integrate[mu p,{mu,-1,1}]; c=Integrate[mu^2 p,{mu,-1,1}]; d=Integrate[(1-mu^2)p/2,{mu,-1,1}]; l=Integrate[(3mu^2-1)p/2,{mu,-1,1}]; {a,b,c,d,l,{a-1,b,c-1/5,d-2/5,l+1/5}}
